assessment.match_notes: Task requires dilute (loang) nitric acid - a colorless solution. The game also has a separate concentrated HNO3 node (runtime-0658-hno3c, 'Nitric acid (dac)'), so the dilute/concentrated distinction is visually and chemically important. Every real nitric acid photograph on Commons shows concentrated acid: labels verified as 70%, 65%, 56%, 'CONCENTRATED NITRIC ACID' (Nitric acid lab.jpg, VLM-verified) or 'HNO3 conc.' (Salpetersaeure.jpg); several show the yellow coloration or fuming caused by dissolved NO2 (Nitric acid yellow.JPG, fuming variants). No photograph of colorless dilute HNO3 could be verified, so the honest result is NO_EXACT_REAL_PHOTO.
